data.headline: Laura Sciove — REALTOR® Associate
data.body: Laura is a REALTOR® Associate with Green Light Realty, serving buyers and sellers across Middlesex, Monmouth, and Ocean County. Reach out for local market expertise and guidance from first showing to closing day.

data.title: How Laura Helps
data.subtitle: Local expertise from first showing to closing day.

items.title: Local Market Expertise
items.description: Laura works Middlesex, Monmouth, and Ocean County every day — pricing, neighborhoods, schools, and what homes are really worth right now.

items.title: Guidance for Buyers & Sellers
items.description: Whether you are buying your first home or selling to move up, Laura walks you through every step so nothing catches you off guard.

items.title: Backed by Green Light Realty

data.title: About Laura
bio: I grew up in Upstate, NY and have been an NJ resident and your Lakeridge West neighbor for 8 years.  I truly fell in love with this area.
This is where my heart told me to buy my home and start my family.  If your looking to sell your home let me put my love for this neighborhood to work for you!
